improvements.title: Security fixes may be closed without sufficient verification
improvements.change: How the effectiveness of a security fix is verified before its finding is closed.
improvements.rationale: A previously resolved security finding was detected again during a pre-release scan. This suggests a potential gap in how the effectiveness of security fixes is verified before findings are closed.
